bibl.title: Sobre la manipulación de versos de Homero en la mántica.
bibl.seg: Raquel Martín Hernández, Sobre la manipulación de versos de Homero en la mántica.

Teresa Martínez Manzano & Felipe G. Hernández Muñoz (edd.), Del manuscrito antiguo a la edición crítica de textos griegos. Homenaje a la Profa. Elsa García Novo = Clásicos Dykinson. Monografías (Madrid, 2019) pp. 211-224.
bibl.note: Focused on a very particular text, the Homeromanteion, a divination by lots text preserved in three papyri from Egypt. The text is composed by 216 Homeric verses to be used as oracular answers. Only a few of these verses do not follow the normalized version of the Homeric works.
